svg.title: Panda App APK Installation Guide
svg.desc: Step-by-step visual guide for installing the Panda APK on Android

g.text: Navigate to your device's Downloads folder
Find the Panda APK and tap to open

svg.text: Your device may need permission to install from unknown sources

g.text: "Allow from this source" or "Install unknown apps"
Complete the installation — you're all set!
